build_collective_all_reduce: build a distributed all_reduce collective that reduces tensor data across all processes using a specified reduction operation
create_collective_all_gather: create a distributed all_gather_into_tensor collective that gathers tensor data from all processes and concatenates along a dimension
create_collective_reduce_scatter: create a distributed reduce_scatter_tensor collective that reduces and scatters tensor results to corresponding ranks
create_async_tensor_wrapper: create an AsyncCollectiveTensor wrapper that delays stream synchronization until the tensor is first used in downstream operations
build_collective_all_to_all: build a distributed all_to_all_single collective that splits and scatters input tensor chunks to all processes in a group
